description: The plot illustrates the training loss of various methods compared to Vanilla over the number of iterations. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140,000 iterations. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," is also a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different method. The Vanilla method is represented by a purple line, StrmLLM (n=64) by a blue line, SepLLM (n=64) by an orange line, SepLLM (n=64, H) by a green line, SepLLM (n=64, H/T) by a red line, and SepLLM (n=128) by a dark blue line. All lines start at a high loss value and decrease as the number of iterations increases, with the loss values converging towards the end of the plot. The lines for SepLLM methods with different parameters (n=64, H, H/T) and SepLLM (n=128) show a similar trend to the Vanilla method, with slight variations in the loss values at different iterations.
